name: Arctic Confrontation
description: A near-peer adversary has established illegal military installations on contested Arctic islands and is enforcing a Northern Sea Route blockade. US and allied forces must project power above the Arctic Circle.

objectives.title: Freedom of Navigation
objectives.description: Assert US navigation rights in the Northern Sea Route.

objectives.title: Destroy Illegal Installations
objectives.description: Neutralize adversary military installations on contested islands.

objectives.title: ASW Operations
objectives.description: Clear adversary submarine threat from Norwegian Sea.

ADVERSARY_A.name: Northern Fleet
ADVERSARY_A.description: Arctic-capable naval forces. Borei SSBNs, Oscar II SSGNs, Kirov battlecruisers.

victory_conditions.DEFEAT: US forces sustain >50% attrition or withdraw
